aub_upgrade_chain_dunhuang_market_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = dunhuang_market_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_dunhuang_market_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = 800 }
		}
		remove_building = dunhuang_market_01
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = dunhuang_market_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = dunhuang_market_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = 800 }
		}
		else = {
			scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
			add_special_building = dunhuang_market_01
		}
	}
}
